meta.name: Recipe: Calm on Silence
meta.description: A deliberately busy scene — a churning plasma field plus a swarm of spectrum dots — that nonetheless falls to a calm, dim, barely-moving idle when the music stops. Every brightness term is multiplied by smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, energy): below ~0.02 energy the gate is 0 and the scene rests at a faint floor; above ~0.12 it is fully lit. Motion speeds are scaled by energy too, so silence settles the swarm. Contract section 3: zeroed features during silence, but t and dt keep advancing — gate by audio, not by time.
meta.author: ViewMusic authoring manual

color.h: 200 + 80 * sin(x * settings.scale + phase) * cos(y * settings.scale - phase)
color.v: (settings.floor_r + settings.floor_g + settings.floor_b) * 0.2 + smoothstep(0.02, 0.12, energy) * (0.2 + 0.8 * abs(sin(x * settings.scale + phase) * cos(y * settings.scale - phase * 0.7)))

element.x: (0.2 + 0.7 * rand(i)) * cos(u * tau + spin + rand(i + 11) * tau) / aspect
element.y: (0.2 + 0.7 * rand(i)) * sin(u * tau + spin + rand(i + 11) * tau)
